purpose: A bare dial with two ink hands and a gold sweeping second hand, nothing else. It refuses ticks, numerals and a centre dot: it was kept on the Slow prototype because the ticks failed to render and the bare face was better.

night.recipe: The bg and ink tokens flip with the palette; the gold second hand stays gold in both.

antiPatterns.rule: Do not add ticks, numerals or a centre pip
antiPatterns.why: the face is defined by their absence; the moment one returns it is Analog

antiPatterns.rule: Never rotate the hands with CSS transforms or transitions
antiPatterns.why: handPoints geometry is what makes a backsweep and a float32 jump impossible by construction
